title: Charcoal, chalk and crayon catch on a paper grain and can be smudged
goal: Three of the brushes start to look like their real media: charcoal is soft and dusty, chalk is coarse and bright, crayon is waxy and broken, and all three catch on the same paper grain so strokes show its tooth. Charcoal and chalk can be smudged with a finger-like Smudge mode.
notes:
Umbrella: a-brush-tool-paints-with-realistic-charcoal-chal (the user's ask, 2026-10-24). Design: docs/design/brushes.md, read it first; its decisions are settled unless this task's runner finds one cannot work, in which case they say so in the log and in the doc.

Design doc decision 4 table, rows Charcoal, Chalk, Crayon, and decision 7 Smudge. Grain is procedural and seeded, never a stored picture of a subject; a tileable noise texture generated at runtime is a tool, which is fine.
acceptance: Each of the three paints with a paper grain fixed to the canvas, so two strokes over the same spot catch the same tooth

Charcoal reads dusty and soft-edged, chalk coarse and opaque, crayon waxy with a hard broken edge; a contact sheet of one stroke each shows three different media to the runner and to a model judge, beside reference photos of each real medium
Grain visibly changes how broken the stroke is, and Smudge (the setting and the Paint / Smudge mode) drags the deposit along the stroke
A walk with no flags paints a stroke with each and smudges the charcoal by pointer drag, with real window pictures in the audit

Measured bar: the stroke sheet fails the round soft tip from the foundation slice (write the measure, for example the fraction of interior pixels left unpainted by grain, and set the threshold where the round tip fails)

log.note: deps set by the umbrella's planning run: pressing-b-picks-a-brush-that-paints-freehand-st

Adversarial review before building: a first-time user picks B and gets charcoal; with no medium control they could never reach chalk or crayon, and the settings slice (each-brush-shows-its-own-settings-in-the-tool-op) is sequenced after this one, so this slice puts Medium (dropdown, seven media) and Mode (Paint | Smudge, segmented) in the tool options capsule now; the settings slice adds Size, Opacity, the medium's own two and the panel section. A Photoshop user expects Smudge to be its own tool (R); the design doc settled it as a brush mode, kept. Smudge over a bare screenshot cannot write into the picture (non-destructive rule), so it does nothing there.

Chose: grain fixed to the paint layer's own points over absolute canvas coordinates because moving a painted layer should carry its look; every stroke on a layer, and every layer made on the same frame, catches the same tooth. Chose: smudge only adds (spreads thinner into lighter places) over lifting paint, because it keeps the live overlay exact and real finger-lifting is a refinement; written in docs/design/brushes.md.

Shipped in 6fddd821: paper grain fixed to the layer, charcoal/chalk/crayon marking, Smudge mode + setting, Medium and Mode in the capsule, measured bar (interior gaps: round tip 0, bar 0.12, charcoal 0.17, chalk 0.38, crayon 0.35), walk brush-dry-media-and-smudge-walk green with 6 real window pictures, audit 2026-10-24-dry-media.json. Pictures looked at: the stroke sheet each iteration and the walk's closeup; they show three textured strokes with streaks along the drag, crayon with squared ends, a soft smudge.

NOT DONE, acceptance item 2: three blind model judges (sheet vs Wikimedia reference photos) named all four rows correctly (crayon and round tip high confidence, charcoal and chalk low to medium) but each said the three read as one grain at different strengths and that charcoal and chalk would not survive a blind swap. Left for the next pass: give chalk its own particle (small, powdery, lighter streaks rather than big blotches; judges called it leopard spots), keep the grain inside a charcoal smudge instead of a smooth comet, break crayon's machine-parallel edges and the fine white hairlines from the stick face. Taper and pressure (every judge's other complaint) belong to pen-pressure-tilt-and-pointer-speed-shape-a-brus. Regenerate the sheet with PHOTONZ_STROKE_SHEET=<dir> Scripts/test.sh --filter StrokeSheet.
Slice shipped (6fddd821): grain, three media, Smudge, measured bar, walk, audit. Open: the blind model judge still cannot tell charcoal from chalk (acceptance item 2); see log.
